summary: ICZOOM Group Inc., a Cayman Islands exempted company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K on May 8, 2026, furnishing a press release that announces a postponement of its extraordinary general meeting (EGM) from May 29, 2026 to August 31, 2026, with the record date changed to August 3, 2026. The postponement was approved by the board to allow the company to focus management attention and internal resources on preparing interim financial statements. This is a routine scheduling change for a previously announced meeting, not a special situation. No deal terms are present; the filing merely updates meeting logistics.
